clue.text: Report delayed by engineers

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, the British Army corps
something delayed is late

explanation.surface: A report is held up because the engineers have not finished their work.
explanation.definitionFit: To relate is to report or narrate events, as in relating a story.

clue.text: Goddess given the bird

definitions.meaning: A Titan goddess, mother of Zeus in Greek myth
a large flightless South American bird resembling an ostrich

explanation.surface: A goddess is presented with a bird as an offering.
explanation.definitionFit: The name belongs both to the Greek Titaness and to a flightless South American bird.

clue.text: Fortune presently in besieged city

parts.note: fortune in the sense of chance is luck
presently can mean at this moment, now

explanation.surface: Good fortune arrives just in time for the people of a city under siege.
explanation.walkthrough: The Siege of Lucknow (1857) was a famous episode of the Indian Rebellion.
explanation.definitionFit: The Indian city was besieged for months during the 1857 rebellion against British rule.

clue.text: Trim binder initially presented by recordproducer?

indicators.note: says the binder is presented first, before the trim, in the answer

parts.note: tape is something used to bind or tie things together
to trim, as in decorating, is to deck

explanation.surface: Someone trims a ring binder, which was first shown off by a man who makes records.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue's 'recordproducer' runs two words together as printed; the question mark flags that a tape deck produces recordings rather than being a person.
explanation.definitionFit: A tape deck is a machine that makes recordings, a whimsical take on a person who produces records.

clue.text: Firework caught in present container?

indicators.note: the letter for caught is put inside the word for tending a fire

parts.note: read as fire work: tending a fire is stoking it
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A firework is found tucked inside a box of gifts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Firework' looks like a rocket or sparkler but splits as 'fire work', the job of stoking.
explanation.definitionFit: A Christmas stocking is hung up to be filled with presents, so it is a container for gifts.

clue.text: Myriad, like the men of York?

definitions.meaning: a myriad strictly means ..., from the Greek
in the nursery rhyme the Grand Old Duke of York had this many men, marching them up and down the hill

explanation.surface: A great crowd, like the soldiers of the Duke of York.
explanation.walkthrough: The Grand Old Duke of York is an English nursery rhyme about a commander who marched his men up a hill and down again.
explanation.definitionFit: Myriad comes from the Greek word for that exact number, and the nursery rhyme gives the duke the same count of soldiers.

clue.text: Copper on trial is most charming

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
a trial is a test

explanation.surface: A police officer facing a trial turns out to be the most delightful of people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copper' suggests a policeman, but it is the metal, symbol CU.
explanation.definitionFit: Cutest is the superlative of cute, meaning most attractive or charming.

clue.text: Prohibition circumvented by US president with a flower arrangement

indicators.note: the ban is surrounded on both sides by the president and the letter A

parts.note: Ike was the nickname of President Dwight Eisenhower
a prohibition is a ban

explanation.surface: An American president gets round a ban, carrying a bouquet.
explanation.definitionFit: Ikebana is the Japanese art of arranging flowers.

clue.text: Reckless lady urged with caution

indicators.note: reckless suggests something careless and wild, so the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A rash woman urged someone to proceed carefully.
explanation.definitionFit: Guardedly means cautiously, in a careful, wary way.

clue.text: Flight in Midwest with Batman accessory

parts.note: the middle letters of the word west
Batman wears a cape

explanation.surface: A flight to the American Midwest is taken with a superhero's cloak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Midwest' is not the American region: it asks for the middle of 'west', ES.
explanation.definitionFit: Flight in the sense of running away from danger is an escape.

clue.text: Song containing single note? A loathsome thing

indicators.note: the song's letters go round the note

parts.note: an anthem is a song, such as a national one
A is one musical note

explanation.surface: A song built around one note makes something hateful.
explanation.definitionFit: Anathema is something or someone intensely loathed or detested.

clue.text: Play with bad lad behind sauna

indicators.note: bad suggests something spoilt or wrong, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A drama featuring a naughty boy loitering at the back of a steam room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' rearranges LAD BEHIND SAUNA (14 letters). An Ideal Husband is a comedy by Oscar Wilde.
explanation.definitionFit: Oscar Wilde's 1895 comedy is one of his best-known stage works.

clue.text: Poet sticking head in river after midday

indicators.note: the head, in and river come after the middle of day

parts.note: the middle letter of the word day
poll is an old word for the head
taken as written
the Aire is a river in Yorkshire

explanation.surface: A poet dunks his head in a river once noon has passed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'midday' is the middle of 'day', A. 'Poll' for head survives in 'poll tax', a tax per head.
explanation.definitionFit: Guillaume Apollinaire was a French poet of the early twentieth century.

clue.text: Early music — such row and discord

indicators.note: discord means disharmony, so the letters are scrambled out of order

explanation.surface: Early music is described as nothing but noise and disharmony.
explanation.definitionFit: The dawn chorus is the birdsong heard at daybreak, music made early in the day.

clue.text: Lawrence accepts greedy bird returned by philosopher

indicators.note: the initials take the word for greedy inside them

parts.note: D. H. Lawrence, the English novelist
avid means eager or greedy

indicators.note: the bird's name is read backwards

parts.note: the emu is a large Australian bird

explanation.surface: A writer takes in a hungry bird that has been sent back by a thinker.
explanation.definitionFit: David Hume was the eighteenth-century Scottish philosopher of empiricism.

clue.text: Rod, getting pale and sickly, died

parts.note: wan means pale and looking unwell
D is the usual abbreviation for died, as in genealogies

explanation.surface: Someone holding a rod went pale, fell ill and died.
explanation.definitionFit: A wand is a thin rod, such as a magician's or conductor's.

clue.text: Of a type of rock since found in the sea

indicators.note: the word for since sits inside the sea's name

parts.note: the Baltic Sea in northern Europe
as can mean since, as in 'as it was late'

explanation.surface: A kind of rock that has been discovered at the bottom of the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Basaltic describes anything made of basalt, a dark volcanic rock.

clue.text: Punitive damages for concealing sacred writings

indicators.note: the two words hold the answer within them, spanning the gap

explanation.surface: Heavy compensation is awarded for hiding holy texts.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer sits in punitiVE DAmages.
explanation.definitionFit: The Vedas are the oldest sacred scriptures of Hinduism.

clue.text: State of French college

parts.note: de is French for of
Clare is a college of Cambridge University

explanation.surface: The status of a French college.
explanation.walkthrough: 'State' looks like a noun but is the verb: to declare is to state.
explanation.definitionFit: To declare something is to state it formally or openly.

clue.text: Humorous remark made by working class about Labour leader

indicators.note: the working class goes round the leader letter

parts.note: the peasantry are the rural working class

indicators.note: a leader is the first letter of a word

explanation.surface: A joke told by labourers about the head of the Labour Party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Labour leader' is the first letter of Labour, L, not a politician.
explanation.definitionFit: A pleasantry is a joking or good-humoured remark.

clue.text: Journeymen with a man in uniform following them

indicators.note: a and the soldier come after the word them

parts.note: a GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A man in uniform tags along behind a group of travellers.
explanation.walkthrough: The Magi were the wise men who journeyed to Bethlehem.
explanation.definitionFit: The Magi made the journey from the East to see the infant Jesus, so they are men who journeyed.

clue.text: Adriatic peninsula or its air force

indicators.note: to force something is to push it out of shape, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A peninsula on the Adriatic, or its national air force.
explanation.walkthrough: 'air force' is not a military unit: 'force' rearranges ITS AIR.
explanation.definitionFit: Istria is a peninsula at the head of the Adriatic, shared by Croatia, Slovenia and Italy.

clue.text: Game birds

definitions.meaning: a pastime of skimming flat stones across water
ducks are female and drakes male, so together they are waterfowl

explanation.surface: Wild birds shot for sport.
explanation.definitionFit: The name is both a stone-skimming pastime and a plain description of male and female ducks.

clue.text: He gets a penny and makes a pile

explanation.surface: A man receives a coin and builds up a fortune.
explanation.definitionFit: A heap is a pile of things lying on top of one another.

clue.text: Find aura unusually bold

indicators.note: unusually signals that the letters appear in an unusual order

explanation.surface: Someone finds a strange atmosphere quite courageous.
explanation.definitionFit: Unafraid means fearless or bold.

clue.text: A twit is relaxed

parts.note: to twit someone is to tease them

explanation.surface: A foolish person is laid-back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twit' looks like a noun for a fool but is the verb meaning tease.
explanation.definitionFit: At ease means relaxed, free from worry or formality.

clue.text: High taxation in East Leeds? Not quite

indicators.note: the tax goes inside the place letters
not quite the whole word, so its last letter is dropped

parts.note: VAT is value added tax, a British sales tax

explanation.surface: Taxes run high in the eastern part of Leeds, almost.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not quite' cuts Leeds to LEED; VAT goes inside E + LEED. Leeds is a city in Yorkshire.
explanation.definitionFit: Elevated means raised up, at a height, so high.

clue.text: Spend little on fabric that's soft

parts.note: scrim is a light open-weave cotton fabric
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, soft

explanation.surface: Someone economises when buying a soft material.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrimp is to economise and spend as little as possible.
